body.p: This document is in response to the Non-Final Office Action dated November 5, 2024 (hereinafter, the "Office Action"), in which claims 1-24 are pending and stand rejected. No claim amendments are being made and no new matter has been added. The Examiner is respectfully requested to reconsider and withdraw the double-patenting rejection in view of the concurrently-filed Terminal Disclaimer to U.S. Pat. Nos. 10,925,487 ("the '487 Patent") and 11,944,405 ("the '405 Patent") and the remarks contained herein.

Claims 1-24 stand rejected allegedly on the ground of non-statutory obviousness- type double patenting over claims 1 and 10 of the '487 Patent and claims 1, 11-12, and 17 of the '405 Patent. As mentioned above, Applicant is concurrently filing a Terminal Disclaimer over the '487 and '405 Patents and, therefore, reconsideration and withdrawal of this rejection are respectfully requested.

It is believed that all of the stated grounds of rejection have been properly traversed, accommodated, or rendered moot. It is believed that a full and complete response has been made to the outstanding Office Action and the present application is in condition for allowance. Thus, prompt and favorable consideration of this Amendment is respectfully requested. If the Examiner believes that personal communication will expedite prosecution of this application, the Examiner is invited to telephone the undersigned below at (563) 663-2549.
